result: Unexpected motion detected when starting position hold; no no-jump guarantee established.

trial.first_process_mode: Software joint origin set, then current-position hold enabled. No motor mechanical zero command.
trial.second_process_comparison: Not run because first process failed the motion guard.
trial.limitation: The failed helper did not print initial angle or exact maximum motion; only guard failure is retained. No exact displacement is claimed.

static_analysis.limitation: Distributed image static analysis; identity with the hardware application image has not been dumped and verified.

other_observation: Warm reactivation can retain old commands. A proposed change and its temporary tests were reverted at the user request.
notes: Stop response mode=Reset and fault flags=0 confirmed after the failed test.
Normal startup initializes the ROS position target from feedback; this alone does not account for the observed multi-turn versus wrapped-coordinate difference.
An in-memory software origin is lost on node recreation. External controllers resending old targets are an additional independent source of movement.
